title: Convert Comments to List
description: Convert the vertical list of comments into a single-line Python list named 'fruits'.
tips:
1. Select the list lines (e.g. 'vip' or 'x' then 'j').
2. Remove comments ('s' -> '^# ' -> 'd').
3. Surround words with quotes ('s' -> '\w+' -> 'ms"').
4. Join everything into one line ('J').
5. Replace spaces with commas ('s' -> ' ' -> 'c, ').
6. Surround with brackets ('mi[') and add 'fruits = '.
